text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI we're consolidating EFL (Emergency Family Leave) + Bereavement into a single handbook section and launching a 6-month pilot. Key points: up to 10 paid days for bereavement + 10 emergency caregiving days (separate buckets), manager attestation in portal, employee e-sign for policy ack, and short 20-min microtraining for claimants in pilot regions (US/UK/DE/CA). Draft: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/efl-bereavement-v1 :page_facing_up:

Harper (Payroll): Payroll needs mapping: paycode, taxable_flag per country, and a periodic export of claims for pay runs. Also need to know whether bereavement is top-up vs statutory in UK/DE.

Soren (Legal): I'll add jurisdiction callouts. DE worker council note and UK statutory bereavement/pay protections will be included. Also recommend consent language for medical/verification attachments.

Lina (Eng Manager): Two asks: (1) manager checklist snippet to include in portal (who to notify, coverage plan), (2) a dashboard widget that surfaces pending manager attestations for my team.

Maya (People Ops): Good asks. We'll add a Manager Checklist and a simple portal widget. Example export + BQ query for audits/payroll below so teams can validate with payroll/SRE: 
```
# HR export - EFL/Bereavement claims
python tools/hr_exports.py --export efl_bereavement_claims --start 2026-09-01 --end 2026-09-30 --format csv > /tmp/efl_claims_sep.csv

# BigQuery quick check
SELECT employee_id, country_code, claim_type, start_date, end_date, days_claimed, manager_id, manager_attested, attested_at, payroll_code, payroll_taxable_flag
FROM `redwood-hr.prod.efl_bereavement_claims`
WHERE submitted_at BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30';
```

training-bot: Microlearning assigned: "EFL & Bereavement - Claim Process (20m)" to employees in pilot regions. Due in 14 days. :books:

Harper (Payroll): Add columns: pay_period, payroll_batch_id, and manager_exception_flag so payroll can tag top-ups correctly. Also share a sample CSV before first payroll run.

Soren (Legal): I'll provide localized wording for DE/UK/CA and a short verification policy (what docs are acceptable) by Wed. Note: DE may need works council notification; will confirm.

i18n-team: We can do EN->FR/DE/ES in ~4 business days post freeze. Please mark placeholders like {policy_link} and {claim_deadline}.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Soren to deliver jurisdiction notes + verification wording by Wed. 2) Harper to validate export columns and request sample CSV by Fri. 3) Eng to scope manager widget (ETA 2 sprints). 4) i18n to queue translations after freeze. 5) People Ops to schedule two 30-min manager drop-ins next week and to publish the claims tracker sheet (managers update attestations). We'll require employee e-sign within 30 days of claim eligibility; People Ops will run weekly missing-ack exports and nudge managers. I'll post the tracker link once ready. Thanks! :handshake:
